indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: Understand the concept of proportion and its relationship to ratios and rates. Use proportional reasoning and rates to solve real-world and mathematical problems.
indicator.objective: Use various strategies to solve proportional reasoning problems involving rates and scales

skills.description: Find a unit rate from a given rate.
Use a unit rate to solve a problem.
Use a scale to find actual distances or drawing distances.

misconceptions: Dividing the wrong quantity when finding a unit rate
Forgetting to convert units when using a scale

questions.stem: 2 kg of meat costs £8. What is the cost of 1 kg?
hints: Divide the cost by the mass.

questions.stem: 5 pens cost £15. What is the cost of 1 pen?
hints: Divide the total cost by the number of pens.

questions.stem: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its speed in km/h?
A sachet of water costs 40p. How much do 6 sachets cost?
3 kg of rice costs £12. What is the cost of 1 kg?
hints: Divide the cost by the mass.

questions.stem: A trotro travels 180 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
If 1 kg of meat costs £4, how much do 5 kg cost?
2 kg of meat costs £8. What is the cost of 5 kg?
hints: Find the unit rate: £8 ÷ 2 = £4 per kg.

questions.stem: A sachet of water costs 40p. What is the cost of 7 sachets?
A car travels 60 km in 1 hour. How far will it travel in 4 hours at the same speed?
hints: Multiply the distance per hour by 4.

questions.stem: 3 kg of rice costs £12. What is the cost of 7 kg?
A pupil reads 30 pages in 2 hours. How many pages will the pupil read in 5 hours at the same rate?
A taxi charges £2 per km. A journey of 15 km costs how much?
hints: Multiply the rate by the distance.

questions.stem: On a map, 1 cm represents 10 km. What distance does 3 cm represent?
A scale is 1:100. What real length does 5 cm on the plan represent?
On a map, 2 cm represents 20 km. What does 7 cm represent?
questions.explanation: 2 cm : 20 km → 1 cm : 10 km. So 7 cm × 10 = 70 km.

questions.stem: A scale is 1:50. What real length does 8 cm on the drawing represent?
On a map, 10 cm represents 10 km. What does 1 km represent on the map?
hints: So 1 km is represented by 1 cm.
questions.explanation: 10 cm : 10 km → 1 cm : 1 km. So 1 km is represented by 1 cm.

questions.stem: A plan has scale 1:200. A room measures 4 cm by 3 cm on the plan. What is the actual area of the room in m²?
questions.misconception: Forgetting to convert cm to m before multiplying.

questions.stem: On a map, 4 cm represents 40 km. What does 15 cm represent?
A scale is 1:500. A garden measures 6 cm by 4 cm on the plan. What is the actual area of the garden in m²?
questions.misconception: Forgetting to convert cm to m before multiplying.
